about_the_game:
Assemble the Ultimate Team of Mexican Wrestlers in This Roguelike Auto-Battler!

Step into the ring and master Lucha Chess, a unique blend of strategy, combat, and roguelike elements. Lead an iconic cast of Mexican wrestlers, each with their own powerful abilities, and combine them with hundreds of items and relics to create the perfect team.

Master the Art of Team Building

Explore endless possibilities as you discover the best team compositions and synergies. Use your strengths to counter your enemies' weaknesses, and adapt your strategy with every battle to stay one step ahead.

An Art Style Inpiresd by Classic Cartoons

Immerse yourself in a vibrant world filled with a distinctive, hand-drawn art style inspired by the charm and energy of classic cartoons. Every frame bursts with personality, bringing the Lucha world to life in ways you’ve never seen before.

Are you ready to assemble your team, take on the toughest challenges, and rise to the top in this action-packed auto-battler? The ring awaits!

Enter the ring with:

  • 30+ unique Wrestlers

  • 100+ items

  • Tons of unique enemies

  • 3 deadly boss fights.
